issues.detail: Skill focuses mainly on happy path migration steps and does not cover all error scenarios and edge cases.

scenarios.name: marketing-site-ssg-migration
scenarios.rationale: Response A better covers rubric items, while Response B lacks App Router and several key requirements.

scenarios.name: dashboard-mixed-rendering
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets all but the real‑time widget requirement, while Response A lacks the app router structure, middleware, cookie forwarding, and the widget.

scenarios.name: nuxt4-migration-with-route-rules
scenarios.rationale: Response B correctly specifies the required routeRules and provides adequate browser-only code examples, while Response A has an incorrect ISR period and both miss data fetching and props serialization details.
